room_rent.note: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses up to 1% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges up to 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: 20% co-payment applies to every claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.display: Cataract ₹40k/eye; Modern Treatments 50% SI; AYUSH 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern Treatments and AYUSH each capped at 50% of Sum Insured

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability and HIV/AIDS; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including hernia, cataract, ENT disorders, calculi, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days from discharge

day_care.note: All day care treatments covered; indicative list of 538+ procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 50% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by an insured is explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic, HIFU, etc.) covered up to 50% of Sum Insured

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded in Annexure II

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; credits for PED, waiting periods transferable

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, organ donation, domiciliary, ART for HIV, alternative therapies, STDs, stem cell storage

optional_riders.note: Only one optional add-on mentioned: waiver of 20% co-payment on payment of additional premium
